      name: RQ-012 souscripteur existant

  # RQ-018 : écart entre la définition Commerciale (au moins un contrat) et la fiche CD-001
  # (contrat en cours ET cotisation à jour sur 3 mois), à la date de référence 2026-10-01

reference.message: Samples are not sent to Soda Cloud

checks.name: RQ-018 ecart client actif commercial vs CD-001
checks.definition:
checks for crm_contrat:
  - ecart_client_actif:
      name: RQ-018 ecart client actif commercial vs CD-001
      ecart_client_actif query: |
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.souscripteur_id)
             - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.date_debut <= '2026-10-01' AND c.date_fin >= '2026-10-01'
                                    AND c.date_derniere_cotisation >= '2026-07-01' THEN c.souscripteur_id END) AS ecart
        FROM crm_contrat c JOIN crm_client k ON k.client_id = c.souscripteur_id
      warn: when > 1000
      fail: when > 5000

# RQ-013 : la valeur sentinelle 0 de assure_id est écartée par un filtre, sinon 40 % de faux orphelins

queries.name: bronze.crm_contrat.contrat_id.duplicate_count
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS frequency
    FROM crm_contrat
    WHERE contrat_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY contrat_id)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frequencies
WHERE frequency > 1

queries.name: bronze.crm_contrat.contrat_id.duplicate_count.failing_sql
queries.sql:
WITH frequencies AS (
    SELECT contrat_id
    FROM crm_contrat
    WHERE contrat_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY contrat_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT main.*
FROM crm_contrat main
JOIN frequencies ON main.contrat_id = frequencies.contrat_id
